metadata.source: 22 original curated F-59 tagging records + 402 QGIS spatially matched mockup points
metadata.date_note: 2026 assumed for demonstration; original data source does not record the year.
metadata.id_note: Original F-59 numeric id values are preserved (all 1); feature id/tag_id are unique. QGIS numeric ids are generated.
metadata.normalization_note: 22 original F-59 records preserved unchanged; simulated QGIS categories normalized into 16 problem types. Original spelling aliases retained in curated records.
metadata.quantity_note: Measurement units are not included, exactly as in the original schema; QGIS ringan/sedang/berat quantities are simulated. Original F-59 values preserved.
metadata.link_note: No user ID, activity ID, observation ID or workflow status in this schema. Handle action plan statuses in separate data/UI.
